claims.statement: Two notebooks on mechanics and geometry, rediscovered in Madrid in 1966. The first belongs to the Milan years, the second to the years in Florence.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Internal dating.
